grownups.title: Grown-ups Area
grownups.lead: See progress, manage profiles and settings, and look after your family's data.
grownups.nav.label: Grown-ups Area
report.title: Progress report: {name}
report.noneNeedHelp: No skills need extra help right now.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.deleteBody: All of this learner's progress, stars, seeds and trophies will be removed from this device. This can't be undone unless you have a backup.
profiles.limit: This device already has {max} profiles, which is the limit. Delete a profile to add a new one.
settings.title: Settings
settings.mathDirection.rtl: Right to left, like Arabic writing
settings.mathDirection.ltr: Left to right, like English writing
settings.arabicOnlyNote: Number style and equation direction apply when the app is in Arabic.
settings.statsNote: Off by default. If turned on, only daily totals such as “practice round finished” would be counted — never names, profiles or exact times. No statistics service is connected in this version, so nothing is sent.
data.title: Backup & data
data.lead: Everything is stored only on this device. Make a backup to keep progress safe.
data.importError.invalid: This file isn't a Number Oasis backup.
data.importError.checksum: This backup file seems to be damaged.
data.importError.version: This backup comes from a newer version of Number Oasis.
data.overwriteBody: {name} already exists on this device. Restoring will replace their current progress with the backup.
data.deleteAllBody: Removes every profile, all progress and all settings from this device immediately.
data.deleteAllTitle: Delete all data on this device?
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.collect.title: What we keep
privacy.collect.body: A nickname, an animal picture, a starting stage, settings, and learning activity such as answers, stars and seeds.
privacy.never.title: What we never collect
privacy.never.body: Real names, birthdays, ages, gender, school, photos, voice, location, contacts or email addresses. There are no ads, no trackers and no chat.
privacy.where.title: Where it is stored
privacy.where.body: Only in this browser on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
privacy.delete.title: Deleting data
privacy.delete.body: You can delete one profile or all data at any time in Backup & data. Deletion happens immediately.
privacy.stats.title: Anonymous statistics
privacy.stats.body: Off by default. Even if a grown-up turns them on, no names, profiles or exact times would ever be included.
privacy.gate.title: The grown-up check
privacy.gate.body: The press-and-hold check keeps young children out of this area. For stronger protection, set a PIN in Settings.
privacy.leavingBody: This opens your email app to send us feedback.
settings.showEarlierNote: Off: a child who starts at a higher stage goes straight to their own skills, and basics from earlier stages are hidden. To move a child up as they grow, change their starting stage in Profiles.
